reader: source-only reader (publisher pictures + page text as sealed in the source package); no analyzer, solver or model output was run or seen for this house

metricCertain.whatTheOverallIncludes: width 1475 = full outer-wall width (460 = the garage block on the plan left + 1015 = the rest of the front wall). depth 1445 = 1070 (the main body under the hip roof, rear wall to front wall) + 375 (the attached garage block that projects FORWARD of the front wall): the overall depth INCLUDES the garage projection; the walls-only depth of the main body is 1070. The rear terrace with its pergola, the entrance canopy and the driveway are outside both figures.
